2026-11-12 22:55:21.547807 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-11-12 22:55:21.547811 | controller |
2026-11-12 22:55:21.547816 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-11-12 22:55:21.547819 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-11-12 22:55:21.547835 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-11-12 22:55:21.547840 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-11-12 22:55:21.547844 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-11-12 22:55:21.547847 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-11-12 22:55:21.547851 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
